Now we have enough data.

Now construct day-by-day plan.

Day 1 March 17: Flight Seattle->Miami, arrival, transport to accommodation. Accommodation: "Charming 1BD Astoria Penthouse" (though location Astoria is NYC? But dataset shows city Miami. We'll assume it's Miami). Provide breakfast maybe on plane, lunch at "Clocked" etc. Dinner at "AB's Absolute Barbecues". Attraction: Wynwood Walls, Bayfront Park.

Day 2 March 18: Miami attractions: Vizcaya Museum & Gardens, South Beach (Lummus Park). Lunch at "Shorts Burger and Shine". Dinner at "Spice It - Hotel IBIS". Accommodation same.

Day 3 March 19: Morning in Miami, then flight to Orlando. Flight Miami->Orlando flight F3714286 dep 18:36 arr 20:01. After arrival, go to accommodation: "Rare Find: SUNNY, LARGE DUPLEX Chelsea 2BR 2BA" (but location Orlando). Provide lunch at "Turquoise Villa". Evening attractions: Universal Studios? maybe The Wheel at ICON Park. Dinner at "Fuji Japanese Steakhouse". Accommodation.

Day 4 March 20: Orlando attractions: SeaWorld Orlando, The Wizarding World of Harry Potter. Lunch at "Indochi Cafe & Restaurant". Dinner at "Bite N Sip". Accommodation same.

Day 5 March 21: Morning Orlando, then rideshare to Tampa. Transportation: Uber. Accommodation: "Bright duplex apartment". Lunch at "Uptown Fresh Beer Cafe". Afternoon attractions: The Florida Aquarium, Busch Gardens. Dinner at "Kobe Hibachi & Sushi". Accommodation.

Day 6 March 22: Tampa attractions: ZooTampa, Tampa Museum of Art. Lunch at "The Tin Cow". Dinner at "Peg Leg Pete's". Accommodation same.

Day 7 March 23: Morning Tampa, then flight Tampa->Seattle flight F3749440 dep 18:08 arr 21:11. Breakfast at hotel. Lunch maybe at airport, dinner back home.

Now need to call submit_day_plan for each day with required fields.

Fields: day, city, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

For days with travel, city may be "from A to B". current_city is destination? The spec: city for this day, if travel between two cities, indicate as "from A to B". current_city: maybe city where staying? Probably same as city. We'll fill.
